planting.note: Plant rooted cuttings or container stock in spring in full sun with sharp drainage; avoid cutting into old wood when shearing.

directions: Hidcote Superior is a Jelitto-introduced, seed-grown English lavender bred as a more uniform and compact improvement on the classic 'Hidcote', with slightly larger flower spikes held over a tighter, more even mound. Deep purple-blue blooms appear from early to late summer on slender stems above narrow, aromatic gray-green foliage. Grow in full sun in well-drained, lean soil of any pH, and deadhead after flowering while trimming only live growth in spring to avoid exposing bare old wood. Once established it tolerates drought well and needs little supplemental water.

common_name: Little Goblin Guy Winterberry Holly (Male Pollinator Winterberry)

planting.note: Plant container-grown shrubs in spring or fall within 50 feet of female winterberries like Little Goblin Red to ensure fruit set; this cultivar sets no berries itself.

directions: Little Goblin Guy is the registered male counterpart bred to pollinate the dwarf Little Goblin winterberry line, including Little Goblin Red and Little Goblin Orange; being male, it produces flowers but never sets fruit. One plant can pollinate five to seven nearby female winterberries as long as it blooms in the same window and is planted within about 50 feet. Like other winterberries it thrives in consistently moist to wet, acidic soil and tolerates boggy sites poorly suited to most shrubs. It needs only minimal pruning and is otherwise grown and sited exactly like its female counterparts.
